gmScreen.Title: GM Screen
gmScreen.ChooseImage: Choose Image for Cell without using a Journal Page
gmScreen.EmptyCellHint: Drag and Drop a Journal Entry, Rollable Table, Actor, or Item from either the World or a Compendium.

gm-screen-config.Name: Grid Tabs
gm-screen-config.Label: Tabs Config
gm-screen-config.Hint: Add, Remove, and Update Grid Tabs here.

columns.Name: Columns
columns.Hint: How many columns do you want? Changing this may require a grid clear.

rows.Name: Rows
rows.Hint: How many rows do you want? Changing this may require a grid clear.

right-margin.Name: Drawer Only: Right Margin
right-margin.Hint: Sets the offset from the sidebar to the right side of the GM Screen. This number affects the maximum possible width of the screen in drawer display mode.

drawer-height.Name: Drawer Only: Height
drawer-height.Hint: Sets the height of the GM Screen in drawer display mode.

drawer-width.Name: Drawer Only: Width
drawer-width.Hint: Calculated as a percentage of the available screen width after the sidebar and right margin are taken into account.

drawer-opacity.Name: Drawer Only: Opacity
drawer-opacity.Hint: Controls how opaque the drawer is.

reset.Name: Reset
reset.Hint: Clear the Grid entries. This action can not be undone.

display-as-drawer.Name: Display as Drawer
display-as-drawer.Hint: Display the GM Screen as a drawer on the bottom of the screen, as opposed to a normal dialog. If you want to use PopOut, set this to false.

transfer.Hint: Export this world's GM Screen setup as a JSON file or import one from another world.
transfer.InvalidFile: This file is not a valid GM Screen export.
transfer.SystemMismatch: This export was created for a different game system and cannot be imported.
transfer.MissingDocumentsExported: The settings were exported, but some referenced documents could not be included.
transfer.ExportFailed: GM Screen settings could not be exported.
transfer.ConfirmContent: This will overwrite this world's GM Screen layout, default rows, and default columns. Referenced documents will be added as new copies and will not overwrite existing documents.
transfer.ExternalFilesHint: Image files are not included and must be available at the same paths in this world.
transfer.ImportDocuments: Also import copies of the referenced documents
transfer.MissingDocumentsImported: Settings imported. Some referenced documents were not included in the file and may not work in this world.
transfer.ImportFailed: GM Screen settings could not be imported. No settings were changed.
transfer.ImportRollbackFailed: The import failed and Foundry could not remove every change. Check the world settings and imported documents.

tab-overflow.Name: Lots of Tabs
tab-overflow.Hint: What the tab bar does when there are more tabs than fit. Scroll keeps one row you can scroll with the arrows or mouse wheel; Wrap stacks the extra tabs in more rows.

journal-view-mode.Name: Journal Page View
journal-view-mode.Hint: How journals in GM Screen cells show their pages when a tab doesn't pick a view of its own in Tabs Config. Works with Force Client Settings, so the GM can lock it for players.

warnings.noGrids: Your GM has not shared any GM Screen Grids.

clearConfirm.Title: Clear Grid
clearConfirm.Content: Are you sure you want to clear the grid entries? This action can not be undone.

table.JournalViewHint: How journals on this tab show their pages. "Use default" falls back to the Journal Page View module setting.
table.RowHint: Which row of tabs this tab sits in. Front is the row touching the screen; Back is the top row. Drawer mode only.

errors.empty: Cannot save the grid with no tabs.

entitySheet.Label: GM Screen Sheet
entitySheet.Hint: Set the sheet used specifically on GM Screen for this item.
